title: MazeBench Clear Ground Turning - official ExB

events.purpose: Stage the single block at (8,12) and reach its southern input stance.
Arrive beside the first clear-ground island; direct R remains blocked.
Use L,U to obtain the western pushing stance.
Push R from the newly reachable stance.
Arrive beside the upper-right clear area.
Use U,R to obtain the northern pushing stance.
Arrive beside the lower-right clear area.
Use R,D to obtain the eastern pushing stance.
Deliver the player to the clear area near the left passage.
Leave the tool and reach the complete left doorway.
